title: CRC-Cascade: Conformal Risk Controlled Cascades for Neural Power Allocation in Dense 6G Mobile Subnetworks
description:
Reference implementation of the paper Conformal Risk Controlled Cascades for Neural Power Allocation in Dense 6G Mobile Subnetworks (G. Arul Dalton and S. V. J. Mani, 2026).

The repository contains a 3GPP TR 38.901 indoor-factory simulator with imperfect CSI, the interference-aware attention network (IAAN) allocator and the MLP and MPGNN baselines, a physics-informed risk scorer, conformal risk control, Learn-then-Test and audit-driven online calibration, the three-stage certified optimizer cascade with group-wise (Mondrian) calibration, the scripts that reproduce every table and figure of the paper, the stored result files, and tests. It is written in pure NumPy and needs no GPU.
